full_rune_text: Ignite the dart, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 43.
Shoot {projectile_count} Poison Darts that deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison each. | Unlocked at level 6.
Shoot a Cold dart that will Slow the enemy by {slow_pct} for {slow_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 13.
Gain {gain_resource} Mana every time a Poison Dart hits an enemy. Converts the damage type to Physical. | Unlocked at level 25.
Transform your Poison Dart into a snake that has a {proc_chance_pct} chance to Stun the enemy for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 52.
Throw a jar with fire spiders that return {gain_resource} Mana to you per hit. | Unlocked at level 55.

Throw a jar with a spider queen that births spiderlings, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | You may have one spider queen summoned at a time. | Unlocked at level 18.
Throw a jar with jumping spiders that leap up to {radius_yards} yards to reach their enemy and attack for a total of {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison. | Unlocked at level 9.
Throw a jar with widowmaker spiders deal a total of {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 33.
Throw a jar with paralyzing spiders that have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to Slow enemies by {slow_pct} with every attack. | Unlocked at level 45.
Mutate to fire bullfrogs that explode for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. | Unlocked at level 17.
Cause toads to rain from the sky that deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison to enemies in the area over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 35.
Mutate to frogs that pierce through enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 24.
Gain {gain_resource} Mana every time a toad hits an enemy. | Plague of Toads' damage turns into Cold. | Unlocked at level 54.
Mutate to yellow toads that deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison and have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to Confuse affected enemies for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 51.

In addition to the base explosion, the skull creates a larger blast that deals an additional {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold to all other enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 60.
The skull can bounce up to {max_count} times. | Unlocked at level 31.
The explosion creates a pool of fire that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 38.

Create a column of flame that spews fire at the closest enemy for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | You may have up to {max_count} Pyrogeists active at a time. | Unlocked at level 47.
Rather than exploding for area damage, each Firebomb can bounce to up to {target_count} additional enemies. Damage is reduced by {damage_dealt_reduction_pct} per bounce. | Unlocked at level 28.
Increase the damage done to {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 15.
Corpses also fall from the sky, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds to nearby enemies. | Unlocked at level 53.
Removes the Mana cost and increases the amount enemies are Slowed to {slow_pct}. | Damage type is changed to Cold. | Unlocked at level 7.
Reduce the cooldown of Grasp of the Dead to {cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Damage type is changed to Poison. | Unlocked at level 28.
Enemies who die while in the area of Grasp of the Dead have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to summon a Zombie Dog. | Damage type is changed to Poison. | Unlocked at level 25.
Summon fewer but larger bats that travel a long distance and deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. | Unlocked at level 11.
Rapidly summon two bats that each seek out a nearby enemy for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. | Unlocked at level 45.
Diseased bats fly towards the enemy and infect them. Damage is slow at first, but can increase over time to a maximum of {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison. | Unlocked at level 29.
Firebats has an initial Mana cost of {cost_resource} mana but no longer has a channeling cost. | Firebats' damage type turns into Physical. | Unlocked at level 19.

Call forth a swirl of bats that damage nearby enemies for {damage_pct:base} weapon damage as Fire. The damage of the bats increases every second, up to a maximum of {damage_pct:maximum} weapon damage after 3 seconds. | Unlocked at level 56.
The spirit returns {heal_per_second_life} Life per second. | Haunt's damage turns into Fire. | Unlocked at level 18.
If there are no enemies left, the spirit will linger for up to {duration_seconds} seconds looking for new enemies. | Unlocked at level 35.
Haunted enemies take {damage_taken_pct} more damage from your attacks. | Haunt's damage turns into Poison. | Unlocked at level 48.
The spirit returns {regen_per_second_resource} Mana per second. | Haunt's damage turns into Physical. | Unlocked at level 57.
Release two spirits with every cast. | Unlocked at level 23.
Engulf the enemy with burning locusts that deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 59.
Locust Swarm has a {proc_chance_pct} chance to jump to two additional enemies instead of one. | Unlocked at level 27.
Enemies affected deal {enemy_damage_pct} reduced damage. | Unlocked at level 37.
Gain {regen_per_second_resource} Mana a second while the first enemy hit by a Locust Swarm cast is still affected by that swarm. | Unlocked at level 33.

Enemies killed while affected by Locust Swarm leave behind a cloud of locusts that deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds to enemies who stand in the area. | Unlocked at level 42.
Your Zombie Dogs burst into flames, burning nearby enemies for {damage_pct} of your weapon damage as Fire every second. | Unlocked at level 40.
Your Zombie Dogs absorb {absorb_pct} of all damage done to you. | Unlocked at level 28.
Your Zombie Dogs gain an infectious bite that deals {damage_pct} of your weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 12.
Enemies who hit or are hit by your Zombie Dogs are Chilled for {chill_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 19.
Your Zombie Dogs heal you for {life_per_hit_share_pct} of your Life On Hit with every attack. | Unlocked at level 54.
Gain {armor_pct} additional Armor for {duration_seconds} seconds after casting Horrify. | Unlocked at level 44.
Increase the radius of Horrify to {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 34.
Enemies are no longer Immobilized and will instead run in Fear for {fear_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 14.
Gain {gain_resource} Mana for every horrified enemy. | Unlocked at level 56.
Increase movement speed by {movement_speed_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds after casting Horrify. | Unlocked at level 21.
Increase your movement speed by an additional {movement_speed_pct} while in the spirit realm. | Unlocked at level 47.
Increase the duration of Spirit Walk to {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 23.
When Spirit Walk ends, your physical body erupts for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 38.
Gain {gain_pct} of your maximum Mana when you activate Spirit Walk. | Unlocked at level 29.
Gain {heal_pct} of your maximum Life when you activate Spirit Walk. | Unlocked at level 53.

Summon a giant toad that pulls in enemies, briefly swallows them whole, then spits them back out with a layer of goo that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds, Slows them, and increases their damage taken by {damage_taken_pct}. | Unlocked at level 43.
Transform into an angry chicken for up to {duration_seconds} seconds that can explode for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 36.
Hexed enemies explode when killed, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 58.
The Fetish Shaman will periodically heal allies for {heal_life} Life. | Unlocked at level 26.
Hexed enemies take {damage_taken_pct} additional damage. | Unlocked at level 31.
Gain {heal_life} Life for every harvested enemy. | Unlocked at level 21.
Gain {movement_speed_pct} increased movement speed for each enemy harvested. | Unlocked at level 39.
Increase your Armor by {armor_pct} per harvested enemy and reduce their movement speed by {slow_pct} for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 32.
Gain mana and increase maximum Mana by {max_pool_pct} for each enemy harvested. | Unlocked at level 15.
Harvested enemies also take {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 49.
Gain {damage_bonus_pct} increased damage done for {duration_seconds} seconds after using Sacrifice. | Unlocked at level 51.
Command all of your Zombie Dogs to charge the target at the same time, each dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 41.
Ichor erupts from the corpse of the Zombie Dog and Stuns enemies for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 18.
Gain {gain_resource} Mana for each Zombie Dog you sacrifice. | Unlocked at level 36.
Each Zombie Dog you sacrifice has a {proc_chance_pct} chance to resurrect as a new Zombie Dog. | Unlocked at level 24.
All enemies in the area of Mass Confusion deal {enemy_damage_pct} less damage for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 46.
Up to {target_count} enemies who are not Confused become Stunned for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 43.
Amid the confusion, a giant spirit rampages through enemies, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage per second as Physical to enemies it passes through. | Unlocked at level 54.
Reduce the cooldown of Mass Confusion to {cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 26.
Enemies killed while Confused have a {proc_chance_pct} chance to spawn a Zombie Dog. | Unlocked at level 34.
Summon zombie bears that stampede towards your enemy. Each bear deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison to enemies in the area. | Unlocked at level 54.
Zombie winter bears crawl out of the ground and run in all directions, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold to nearby enemies. | Unlocked at level 33.
Summon a tower of zombies that falls over, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical to any enemies it hits. | Unlocked at level 21.
If the Zombie Charger kills any enemies, it will reanimate and charge nearby enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison. This effect can repeat up to {max_count} times. | Unlocked at level 27.
Summon an explosive Zombie Dog that streaks toward the enemy before exploding, dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 42.
Gain {heal_per_hit_life} Life each time Spirit Barrage hits. | Unlocked at level 44.
An additional {projectile_count} spirits seek out other enemies and deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire. | Unlocked at level 32.

Summon a spectre that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds to all enemies within {radius_yards} yards. | You can have a maximum of {max_count} Phantasms out at one time. | Unlocked at level 37.
Gain {gain_resource} Mana each time Spirit Barrage hits. | Unlocked at level 23.
Summon a spectre that hovers over you, unleashing spirit bolts at nearby enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 59.
Raise a corpse from the ground that explodes for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire to enemies in the area. | Unlocked at level 55.
Increase the initial area of effect of Acid Cloud to {radius_yards} yards. | Unlocked at level 26.
The acid on the ground forms into a slime that irradiates nearby enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 30.
Create pools of frost to deal {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 39.
Spit a cloud of acid that deals {damage_pct:initial} weapon damage as Poison, followed by {damage_pct:dot} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 46.
Raise a circle of zombies from the ground that traps and attacks nearby enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 41.
Summon a deadly ring for {duration_seconds} seconds that poisons nearby enemies for {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 32.

Summon a circle of spirits for {duration_seconds:circle} seconds that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold, Chills nearby enemies by {chill_pct}, and reduces their damage dealt by {enemy_damage_pct} for {duration_seconds:debuff} seconds. | Unlocked at level 60.
Increase the width of the wall to {radius_yards} yards. All enemies in front of you are knocked back behind the wall. | Unlocked at level 35.

Raise a wall of flame {radius_yards} yards wide for {duration_seconds} seconds that burns enemies who walk through, causing them to take {damage_pct} weapon damage as Fire over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 49.
A giant bogadile emerges from the pool of water, Stuns, and bites a monster dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage as Physical. | Unlocked at level 62.
Turn the piranhas into zombie piranhas. The piranhas will leap out from the pool savagely at nearby enemies | Unlocked at level 63.

The pool of piranhas becomes a tornado of piranhas that lasts {duration_seconds} seconds. Nearby enemies are periodically sucked into the tornado. | Increases the cooldown to {cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 65.

Turn each cast into a wave of piranhas that crash forward dealing {damage_pct} weapon damage and causing all enemies affected to take {damage_taken_pct} increased damage for {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 67.
Changes the damage dealt to {damage_pct} weapon damage as Cold over {dot_duration_seconds} seconds, chilling enemies for the entire duration. | Unlocked at level 69.

When the Gargantuan encounters an elite enemy or is near {nearby_enemy_count} enemies, it enrages for {duration_seconds} seconds gaining: | {movement_speed_pct} movement speed | {attack_speed_pct} attack speed | {damage_bonus_pct} Physical damage | This effect cannot occur more than once every {internal_cooldown_seconds} seconds. Elite enemies include champions, rares, bosses, and other players. | Unlocked at level 29.

The Gargantuan is surrounded by a poison cloud that deals {damage_pct} weapon damage as Poison per second to nearby enemies. | Unlocked at level 48.

Summon a more powerful Gargantuan to fight for you for {duration_seconds} seconds. The Gargantuan's fists burn with fire, dealing {damage_pct} of your weapon damage as Fire and knocking enemies into the air. | Unlocked at level 39.
The Gargantuan gains the ability to periodically slam enemies, dealing {damage_pct} of your weapon damage as Fire and stunning them for {stun_duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 56.

Increase the duration of the ritual to {duration_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 31.

Increase number of dagger-wielding Fetishes summoned by {pet_count}. | Unlocked at level 46.

Decrease the cooldown of Fetish Army to {cooldown_seconds} seconds. | Unlocked at level 40.
